name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Square page links with chevrons, as composable parts or a ready-made control with ellipses.
improvements: PaginationControl computes the visible range with ellipses for any number of pages; Materialize left that to you.
The current page has aria-current="page" and previous/next chevrons have accessible names.
Disabled chevrons use aria-disabled, so keyboard focus is not lost when you reach the first or last page.
Render real links (getHref) for crawlable, server-side pagination, or buttons with onPageChange.
